title: Self-normalized Bernstein Inequalities for Regenerative Processes and Applications to Learning Without Independence
abstract: arXiv:2610.30119v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We prove a self-normalized Bernstein inequality for bounded functions of a regenerative process with independent, identically distributed marked cycles of finite mean length. The bound uses observed cycle lengths and retains explicit terms for truncation and the cycle ending after the observation horizon. Selecting a tuning parameter from a finite deterministic collection gives a version of Bernstein inequality where all terms are empirical but one, related to the tails of the regeneration times. We then study this term in many regimes: it turns out that it is of second-order in many cases of interest. This is important for applications in machine learning: we prove generalization error bounds for classification with non-i.i.d., regenerative data. These bounds can be used to define learning objectives: by minimizing the first-order term only in the bound, we define agnostic classifiers that still satisfy oracle inequalities. We also show

translated_title: 再生过程的自归一化Bernstein不等式及其在无独立性学习中的应用
translated_abstract: 我们针对具有独立同分布、平均周期长度有限的标记周期的再生过程的有界函数，证明了一个自归一化的Bernstein不等式。该界利用了观测到的周期长度，并对截断以及观测窗口结束后才终止的周期保留了显式项。通过从一个有限的确定性集合中选取调节参数，我们得到了一种Bernstein不等式的版本，其中除一项与再生时间的尾部相关外，其余所有项均为经验项。随后我们在多种情形下研究这一项：结果表明，在许多令人关注的情形中，它是二阶小量。这对机器学习中的应用具有重要意义：我们针对使用非独立同分布的再生数据的分类问题证明了泛化误差界。这些界可用于定义学习目标：通过仅最小化界中的一阶项，我们定义了仍然满足预言机（oracle）不等式的不可知分类器。我们还表明……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文为具有独立同分布标记周期的再生过程证明了自归一化Bernstein不等式，其中与再生时间尾部相关的项在多数情形下仅为二阶小量，并据此为非独立同分布的再生数据分类建立了泛化误差界，进而提出满足预言机不等式的不可知分类器。
en_tdlr: The paper proves a self-normalized Bernstein inequality for regenerative processes with i.i.d. marked cycles—where the regeneration-time tail term is only second-order in many regimes—and uses it to derive generalization error bounds for classification with non-i.i.d. regenerative data and to define agnostic classifiers that satisfy oracle inequalities.
